data.title: Bug: `no-unreachable` reports export declarations that aren't evaluated where they appear
data.titleHTML: Bug: no-unreachable reports export declarations that aren't evaluated where they appear
data.body:
### Environment

Node version: v24.20.0
npm version: v11.19.0
Local ESLint version: v10.9.1
Global ESLint version: v10.9.1
Operating System: Windows 11

### What parser are you using?

Default (Espree)

### What did you do?

<details>
<summary>Configuration</summary>

```js
export default [
  {
    rules: { "no-unreachable": "error" },
  },
];
```
</details>

```js
throw new Error();
export function foo() {}
export { foo as bar };
export * from "./other.js";
export var x;
```


### What did you expect to happen?

No errors. None of those four statements does any work at the position where it’s written. They’re hoisted or resolved during module instantiation, before the module body runs at all.

### What actually happened?

```
2:1  error  Unreachable code  no-unreachable
3:1  error  Unreachable code  no-unreachable
```

### Link to Minimal Reproducible Example

https://eslint.org/play/#

### Participation

- [x] I am willing to submit a pull request for this issue.

### AI acknowledgment

- [x] I did not use AI to generate this issue report.
- [ ] (If the above is not checked) I have reviewed the AI-generated content before submitting.

### Additional comments

_No response_
